text: You turn 60. Someone gives you a card with a cartoon tortoise on it. It's a compliment, apparently.

right.label: Big do
right.result: Three generations and one DJ. The DJ is your nephew.

risk.result: You land badly and the whole family watched.

death.cause: The parachute opened a second too late.

text: HR has sent a leaflet called 'Your Next Chapter'. The chapter has a lot of white space.

left.label: Keep working
left.result: You are indispensable. This is not as nice as it sounds.

right.label: Name the day
right.result: You circle it in red. Then you go to bed at nine to celebrate.

risk.result: The island has one shop. It closes at three.

text: The leaving do is in the pub. Everyone you have worked with for thirty years says 'we must keep in touch'.

right.label: Make the speech
right.result: Nobody keeps in touch. The speech was lovely, though.

risk.result: The first gig is a wedding. It's not going well.

text: It's Tuesday. You have no work, no plans and nobody who needs you. The day is very long.

left.label: Watch the telly
left.result: You know the quiz show's whole cast now.

right.label: Find a routine

risk.result: It didn't go to plan.

right.result: Walk, coffee, library, walk. You are, briefly, unstoppable.

risk.result: Blisters. Rain. A very long day four.

text: Your child hands you a small, furious person. It is your grandchild. It has your nose.

left.label: Offer a finger
left.result: It grips you. Your knees stop being the main news.

right.label: Volunteer to babysit
right.result: You are the favourite. You are also very tired.

risk.result: Your child wanted a bit of space.

text: The grandchildren are coming for the weekend. There is one biscuit tin and eight hours of energy.

right.label: Bake together

risk.result: It didn't go to plan.

right.result: There's flour on the ceiling. You'll find it in March.

risk.result: There's glitter on the ceiling now.

text: The surgeon says your hip is 'a bit worn'. You have also, it turns out, been walking funny.

right.label: Have the operation
right.result: Six weeks of the walking frame, then the stairs are just stairs again.

up.label: Go abroad for the cheaper operation

risk.result: A complication. Back home, back in hospital.

text: The optician says the world looks like it's behind a bath curtain because it is. It can be fixed.

right.label: Book the lasers
right.result: The grass is a colour you'd forgotten.

risk.result: One eye is great. The other has opinions.

text: You now take eleven tablets a day. They live in a plastic box with the days of the week on it.

right.label: Stick to the box
right.result: Thursday is, somehow, always empty by Wednesday.

risk.result: The doctor has a one-line report on your decision.

death.cause: Dropping the tablets caught up with you.

text: The rug moved. You went with it. You're lying on the floor looking at the underside of your own sofa.

left.label: Get up alone
left.result: Eventually. Slowly. With a lot of language.

right.label: Press the button
right.result: The pendant works. The voice on the other end is very kind about it.

up.label: Get up and prove you can

risk.result: You can't. You wait three hours.

text: The stairs have started to look like a mountain. There's a bungalow on the next street.

left.label: Stay put
left.result: Forty years of memories on the walls. And the stairs.

right.label: Move to the bungalow
right.result: You find thirty-one jars of buttons you don't recall buying.

risk.result: The engine fails in a lock. Then it rains.

text: Another name has crossed out of the address book. You're now the person who remembers the funny story.

right.label: Go and tell it

risk.result: Mostly fine. Mostly.

right.result: They laugh and cry at the same moment. That's the point of it.

risk.result: Item three was a bungee jump. Your back remembers.

text: Your partner is poorly, and the doctor is using 'long term' about it. You're now the carer.

right.label: Do it yourself
right.result: It's the hardest thing. You wouldn't give it to anyone else.

up.label: Sell up and take them somewhere warm

risk.result: Treatment abroad is a different matter.

text: The house is quiet in the evenings. You keep making tea for two.

left.label: Sit in the quiet
left.result: You say a few words to the chair. The chair gets it.

right.label: Ring your child

risk.result: There was a catch.

right.result: 'Come round for lunch', they say. You were hoping they'd say that.

risk.result: Their kit, their stool, their silence.

text: You've met someone at the choir. They laugh at your jokes. They have, frankly, excellent knees.

right.label: Ask them for coffee
right.result: Coffee turns into dinner. Dinner turns into a Tuesday-and-Thursday arrangement.

risk.result: They snore. And leave the kettle on.

text: A young man from your bank would like your PIN, urgently. He's very polite. He's also breathing like a man at a call centre.

left.label: Give him the number
left.result: It takes you a week to say it out loud.

right.label: Hang up on him

risk.result: You paid for it later.

right.result: He rings back in eleven minutes. You put the phone in a drawer.

risk.result: He was better at this than you were.

text: Your grandchild wants to show you a thing called a 'video call'. Your face is enormous in it.

right.label: Learn it
right.result: You hold it upside down for the first fifteen minutes.

up.label: Open an account and post daily

risk.result: Someone gets your details. It's a hard day.

text: The allotment committee has a plot going. It has been fallow, they say, for 'a while'. It is a small forest.

right.label: Take it on
right.result: You grow a marrow the size of a dog. People ask you for tips.

risk.result: Slugs. All of them. In one night.

text: The brochure says: 'Unpack once.' You like the sound of that. You like the buffet even more.

right.label: Book the cabin
right.result: You meet a couple from Leeds. You keep in touch, for real.

up.label: Sell the car and sail the Atlantic

risk.result: The crossing is rough. The captain isn't nice.

death.cause: The storm took the boat. You went with it.

text: The solicitor has papers. There are choices about who gets the house, the spoons, and the cat.

right.label: Settle it today
right.result: The cat gets the armchair. The rest is up to the family.

up.label: Leave it all to a stranger's charity

risk.result: The family isn't speaking to you.

text: You went upstairs for something. You are now upstairs. This has happened before.

right.label: See the doctor
right.result: 'Perfectly normal for your age.' You write it down, so you won't forget.

risk.result: A side effect nobody mentioned.

text: Your grandchild says: 'Tell me what it was like.' It was, you realise, quite a lot.

right.label: Tell the whole story

risk.result: You paid for it later.

right.result: It takes four afternoons. The grandchild takes notes, and a few liberties.

risk.result: A cousin hears what you said about her wedding.

text: The community hall does a tea dance on Thursdays. A woman in a sequined cardigan beckons.

right.label: Take her hand

risk.result: It didn't go to plan.

right.result: Your waltz is mostly standing. She says it's the best she's had.

risk.result: You pull something on the first lift.

text: Your child gently shows you a brochure. It has a conservatory and a lot of cheerful photos of nurses.

left.label: Refuse
left.result: You stay home, and you're stubborn about it. They worry.

right.label: Go and look
right.result: It's a nice place. The quiz is on Wednesdays. You'd win.

up.label: Buy a retirement flat in a village

risk.result: The service charge is a work of fiction.

text: You are 80. The mayor sends a card. So does the king. So does a double-glazing company.

right.label: Pop the cork
right.result: Four generations and a very nice cake.

up.label: Rent a castle for the weekend

risk.result: The staircase is a lot. As is the bill.

text: You are 100. A reporter asks for the secret. You are tempted to say 'luck', but it's a slow news day.

right.label: Say 'gin'

risk.result: There was a catch.

right.result: It makes the front page. Your family have to explain it to the vicar.

up.label: Tell the truth about all of it

risk.result: Your relatives read the papers the next day.

text: The flu is going round the street. You're being very good at getting it.

right.label: Call the doctor
right.result: Soup, antibiotics and a stern voice. Two weeks later you're up.

up.label: Go to the hospital and demand antivirals

risk.result: The ward has the worst bug of all.

text: You find a box of photographs. A young person is grinning in every one. You know the grin.

right.label: Look through them all

risk.result: There was a catch.

right.result: You lose an afternoon. It was well spent.

up.label: Track down everyone in the photographs

risk.result: Most of them have died. You find out one at a time.

text: The park bench is free. The ducks look expectant.

right.label: Do a lap
right.result: You do one and a half laps and call it two.

risk.result: You have to get a taxi back. The taxi driver lectures you.

text: The neighbour wants to chat over the fence. It's been twenty minutes and you know about the bins.

risk.result: They've brought their opinions on politics.

text: The crossword has one clue left. It has been one clue left since breakfast.

right.label: Keep going

risk.result: It didn't go to plan.

right.result: Nineteen across was 'ennui'. Of course it was.

risk.result: The answer was one letter off. In print.

text: Another appointment. The waiting room magazines are from a different decade.

risk.result: They find three things to watch.

text: The phone rings. It's family, and they sound pleased you picked up.

risk.result: You paid for it later.
It's been so long that someone asks who you are.

text: It's cold out. There's a stew in your future if you want one.

right.label: Make the stew
right.result: Enough for six. You live alone. The freezer is happy.

risk.result: Eleven people. One oven. No more spoons.

text: The afternoon sun is on the armchair. It has your name on it.

risk.result: There was a catch.
You wake up sunburnt and soaked.

text: A robin keeps watching you dig. It's expecting worms.

risk.result: It chooses the neighbour's.

text: The news is terrible again. You've heard all of this before, with different names.

risk.result: Form letter. Same one as last time.

text: An old song comes on. You remember exactly where you were.

risk.result: Not everything went your way.
Your hip says no.

text: The stairs are a lot. You have a choice about how to do them.

left.label: One at a time, holding on

right.label: Race to the top
right.result: Nobody saw. You were not fast.

up.label: Install the stairlift and race it

risk.result: It has an emergency brake. It uses it.

text: The shop has a new self-service till. It speaks to you, and it's wrong about the bananas.

right.label: Fight the machine
right.result: You win. The queue behind you does not applaud.

risk.result: The manager reads it at the till. Out loud.
